title: Unintentional Data Sharing
description: The child's device may unintentionally share GPS coordinates with unauthorized parties due to misconfigured settings or vulnerabilities in the mobile app.

title: Data Interception
description: Live GPS coordinates transmitted over the network may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized tracking of the child's location.

title: Inadequate Data Protection
description: The backend may not implement sufficient security measures to protect the received GPS data, leading to potential data breaches.

title: User Profiling
description: The backend may use the GPS data to create detailed profiles of the child without proper consent, leading to privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose location data to unauthorized users or systems during the process of writing to the Location History Store.

title: Insecure Storage of Location Data
description: The Location History Store may not implement adequate security measures, leading to potential unauthorized access or data breaches of stored location data.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Location data may be intercepted during transmission from the mobile app backend to the Location History Store, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Location Data Exposure
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive location data when forwarding pings to the Geofencing Engine, leading to potential unauthorized access to user location information.

title: Interception of Location Data
description: Location pings transmitted from the mobile app backend to the Geofencing Engine could be intercepted during transit, allowing unauthorized parties to access sensitive location information.

title: Improper Data Handling
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may process or store location data in a way that does not comply with privacy regulations, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized sharing of user location information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Family Account Data
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the Family Account Store, leading to exposure of sensitive zone definitions.

title: Inaccurate Geofencing Alerts
description: If the Geofencing & Alert Engine misinterprets the zone definitions, it may trigger false alerts, leading to user confusion or panic.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Zone definitions may be intercepted during transmission from the Family Account Store to the Geofencing Engine, exposing sensitive location information to unauthorized parties.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The Geofencing Engine may inadvertently share location data with unauthorized parties if proper access controls are not in place.

title: Data Interception
description: The arrival/departure notifications could be intercepted during transmission, allowing unauthorized parties to access sensitive location information.

title: Inadequate Data Protection
description: The parent may store or process the received notifications without adequate security measures, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The parent may use the location data for purposes other than intended, such as profiling or tracking the child without consent.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent may not fully understand what data is being collected or how it will be used, leading to inadequate consent for data sharing.

title: Data Misuse
description: The mobile app backend may misuse the child's profile data (name, DOB, school) for purposes other than intended, such as marketing or selling to third parties.

title: Data Breach
description: The mobile app backend may be vulnerable to data breaches, exposing sensitive information about the child and parent.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The child's profile data may be stored insecurely, making it susceptible to unauthorized access.

title: Unclear Data Retention Policies
description: The mobile app backend may not have clear policies on how long the child's data will be retained, leading to potential over-retention.

title: Unauthorized Access to Account Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose account data to unauthorized users due to insufficient access controls.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Family Account & Permissions Store may store sensitive data without proper encryption, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Family Account & Permissions Store may retain personal data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data transmitted from the mobile app backend to the Family Account & Permissions Store may be intercepted if not properly secured.

title: User Profiling Risks
description: The data stored in the Family Account & Permissions Store could be used for user profiling without explicit consent.

title: Informed Consent
description: The parent may not be fully informed about what data is being shared with the mobile app backend, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Retention
description: The mobile app backend may retain location data longer than necessary, posing a risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Identity Disclosure
description: The data flow may expose metadata that could link the parent to the child's location, potentially leading to identity disclosure.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The mobile app backend may use the location data for purposes other than those intended by the parent, such as marketing or profiling.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The location history may be shared with unauthorized parties if proper access controls are not in place at the data store.

title: Insecure Data Processing
description: The mobile app backend may process the location history in an insecure manner, leading to potential exposure of sensitive data.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Location data may be intercepted during transmission from the data store to the mobile app backend, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Unintentional Data Sharing
description: The parent may unintentionally share sensitive information about the child with the secondary guardian, leading to potential misuse of that information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The mobile app backend may store the child's location data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access.

title: Data Interception
description: Data transmitted between the parent and the mobile app backend may be intercepted by malicious actors, exposing the child's location.

title: Unauthorized Access by Secondary Guardian
description: The secondary guardian may gain unauthorized access to the child's location data if proper access controls are not implemented.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently grant access to the secondary guardian without proper authentication or authorization checks, leading to unauthorized access to the child's live location data.

title: Misuse of Shared Location Data
description: The secondary guardian may misuse the child's live location data for purposes other than intended, such as stalking or harassment.

title: Interception of Location Data in Transit
description: The child's live location data may be intercepted during transmission from the backend to the secondary guardian, leading to potential privacy breaches.

title: Inadequate Data Minimization
description: The backend may share more data than necessary for the purpose of analytics, leading to potential overexposure of user data.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The advertising/analytics partner may not store the received data securely, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Lack of Anonymization
description: The aggregated data shared may still contain identifiable information that could be used to re-identify users, violating privacy expectations.

title: Informed Consent
description: The child may not fully understand the implications of sending their location data, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Linkability
description: The SOS message may include metadata that can be used to link the child's identity to their location, potentially exposing them to unwanted tracking.

title: Data Retention
description: The mobile app backend may retain the child's location data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Unintended Disclosure
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently disclose the child's location data to unauthorized parties due to inadequate access controls.
